title: International selection
about: ENS-PSL's International Selection (Sciences) for 2027 accepts applications via OnePSL30 from 16 October to 15 December 2026, 14:00 Paris time. Candidates must be under 26 and have at least one year of undergraduate study abroad.
card_alt: Card for the International selection (Sciences) at École normale supérieure - PSL (ENS), Paris, France, application deadline 15 Dec 2026. The photo is an aerial view of the Eiffel Tower above the Champ de Mars, with the Palais de Chaillot and the La Défense skyline behind it.
